title: Generated Form Step
description: The schema information used to render a single step of a form. The jsonSchema validates the slice of submission data corresponding to that step's fields.

jsonSchema.description: The slice of the template's referenced schema covering the properties targeted by this step's field slots, with '$ref's expanded and 'required' declarations preserved.

uiSchema.description: The UI Schema describing how this step's properties are rendered. Defined by react-jsonschema-form.
